name: Simit Seller

intro.text: Simit! Sesame rings, fresh this morning. You look hungry and argumentative. Let's battle first.

win: Fair enough. Have a simit anyway.
after: Pastry here is a serious business. Börek, pirohu, pilavuna at Easter-time for Greek Cypriots and at Bayram for us. Same cheese inside, two names outside. You see the pattern.
